subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept a defaults-wide `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` config surface after the pending-BOOTSTRAP safety fix, or should tiered bootstrap policy be redesigned around a narrower per-agent/bootstrap-profile model?
rationale: The code blocker is mechanical, but adding a new global context/session-state config is a maintainer product decision under repository policy.

options.title: Accept after safety/docs fixes
options.body: Keep this PR as the implementation path once pending `BOOTSTRAP.md` is preserved and docs/tests cover the public config behavior.

options.title: Redesign as profile policy
options.body: Pause this PR and move the idea toward per-agent or bootstrap-profile controls if maintainers do not want a global defaults-wide tier knob.

options.title: Defer the config surface
options.body: Close or park the PR if the token-saving use case should be handled only by existing budgets, context modes, or future context-management work.

recommendation.title: Accept after safety/docs fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the implementation path once pending `BOOTSTRAP.md` is preserved and docs/tests cover the public config behavior.
